_comment: Edit this, not the code. Models are Claude Code aliases (opus/sonnet/haiku) or full model ids. max_cost_usd and worker_budget_usd are the SDK's local token-cost ESTIMATE at API list prices, not money billed on a subscription — useful only as a relative throttle. On a subscription the real limit is your plan's usage cap; max_cycles is the ceiling that matters.
goal:
Phase 2 — routines, conflicts, protected time and the menu bar extra (BRIEF-PRODUCT.md "Phase 2"). The Phase 2 UI spec landed in design/ (the commit titled "Phase 3" added it; see components.md "What Phase 2 must render for review") but no Phase 2 code exists: no RoutineEngine, no conflict detection, no TimeWindow editor, no MenuBarExtra, no Snooze. Do not start Phase 3.

FIRST, before any Phase 2 work: three defects Parsa found running the app on 2026-09-10. These are Phase 1 correctness and they outrank new features. Screenshots are committed at screenshots/ (day-full-light.png, week-full-dark.png, month-full-light.png) and indexed in INDEX.md.

1. CRASH — highest priority. Esc and Return crash the app. Reproduce, capture the crash, fix, and add a regression test. A crash outranks everything else in this list.

2. Click-to-select does nothing. Clicking an event block in the calendar has no effect. Establish first whether selection is wired at all or is broken: interactions.md specifies it and STATUS.md claims a selected state exists, so this is either a regression or a spec item that was never built. If the spec does not cover the click target or hit area, that is a GAPS entry, not an invented value.

3. Block overlap, visible in the committed screenshots. Concrete symptoms, all on Wed 9 Sep with the mock fixtures: (a) between 12:00 and 13:00 two blocks render as thin bars roughly one line tall showing only a glyph and no title, stacked directly on top of each other — visible in both Day and Week; (b) at about 18:00 in Week a magenta block, a blue block and a dashed block overlap; (c) the "Leave 08:38 - 22min" travel band overlaps the bottom edge of the Morning review block it belongs to, and in Day the Datenmodellierung block starts on top of it. Determine for each whether the layout engine is wrong or the spec's packing/cascade rules are being misapplied, and fix the one that is actually wrong. The Thu cascade cluster with the +1 chip looks correct per layouts.md and is not part of this.

THEN Phase 2, in the brief's order: routines and the routine engine, conflict detection with ranked options, protected and low-energy time windows honoured by scheduling, the menu bar extra with its next-up popover and its empty and late states, and snooze that shows where the item moved to.

Phase 2 is not done until screenshots/2/ is populated with an INDEX.md and DA has reviewed those captures against the spec.
